# Source04 original-object machine supplement and final qualification

FINAL INDEPENDENT VERDICT: **CORRECT / FORMALLY QUALIFIED FOR THIS EXACT SOURCE AND ORIGINAL OBJECT**. `formalQualified=true`. The complete source-review chain, actual native004 pass, same-original-object exhaustive TYPE/FULLVALUE/recursive AX evidence, public-interface reading, and pinned-dependency/warning explanation are all present and hash-bound. No material mathematical or evidence gap remains in this bounded unit.

This supplement concerns only source04 SHA256 `2a50f66982b41f472dd00cfd87ee0922112494d470f317e21290a1e28d30321c`, 128743 bytes / 2232 LF, and its original successful `producer004.olean` SHA256 `140d049dd3e6437d406eadc0ecdcb279b5427ec85039bb12b4be63ef0170463e`, 6823048 bytes. ## Exact source, original object, and audit chain

The source-stage REPORT SHA256 is `01fcaa98226c4f8da1c0e5b6676c4edb39d24f1f054d72dc2fef4559389f4ed8`; its OUTPUT-SEALS SHA256 is `a1c63ff1b84d8dbeb4142b05f7bba7bf98c673c05b7b1bf316aec98c3cfe5302`, covering 11 payloads. Those exact source-stage bytes, including its then-pending formal status, remain unchanged. The source stage completely reviewed all four source04 affected proofs, exact differences, all 90 textual data values and contexts, every source binding and frozen declaration; unchanged material reuses the complete source01/candidate, source02 and source03 reviews at their exact hashes. This supplement does not repeat those complete old proofs.

The read-only native/upload/install/audit/extraction requests and actual responses have been read. The preflight binds source03's natural failure and absence of uncertain native004 files. Upload sends the exact source04 to both the actual worktree source and its immutable attempt004 source copy. The native request checks equality of those bytes, exact SHA256 and LF, then invokes the complete target once under phase26 CPU40–43/root-heavy.lock with `lake env lean -M8192 -j4 -o producer004.olean`. It does not recompile old accepted producers or weaken declarations/options.

The actual native004 receipt reports natural RC0, zero errors, 152 warnings, and the successful original object above; source-before and source-after are the same reviewed SHA256. The installation request first verifies the source and original object hashes and successful receipt, requires that the canonical alias be absent, and installs a symlink to that exact original object. Installation records `producerRecompile=false`, original bytes and mtime, and the canonical module alias target. It does not run a second producer build.

The actual audit request imports that module through the installed alias, verifies source, original object and OwnedAudit template hashes, and performs one audit of the original object under the same phase/lock/native limits. `audit001-receipt.json` reports natural RC0 and zero errors. Its post-audit original-object SHA256 remains exactly `140d049dd3e6437d406eadc0ecdcb279b5427ec85039bb12b4be63ef0170463e`. The reviewer relies on these exact local read-only receipts, not an independently executed server process observation or a locally copied binary.

The audit template SHA256 is `07610dbb29b088fb858cdf24867bc333718f4bef4d2909cd9deceef2fc4f5537`. Its complete source was read. It enumerates every environment constant and selects exact `env.getModuleIdxFor?` ownership, rather than a namespace prefix or a manually copied name list. It checks recursive `Lean.collectAxioms` for each selected constant and throws on any axiom outside the whitelist. With `pp.all=true` it prints every actual type, and prints the complete value of every owned definition or opaque constant. Unsupported non-theorem kinds throw instead of being omitted. It checks that the sole expected public theorem is actually a theorem and present exactly once.

The existing v105 worktree preparation evidence binds accepted base `1715383c446b16125481e1c30493661741fb1ee5`, checks 870 accepted Shao sources, and installs 1655 thin aliases without source upload, Lean/AX or package writes. Its complete 343-module Shao import-closure source/object map was parsed deterministically; every one of its 343 source hashes matches the current curated library file. The ten direct Shao imports have the same previously accepted source and original object bindings, including Endstrip05, LowFullEnergy05, OrdinarySuffixWeight03 and WRS. This verifies dependency reuse, not a repeated proof review or kernel replay of those accepted modules.

The extraction response binds all seven principal evidence files with full byte lengths and SHA256. Those seven local files independently rehash to the exact response entries. The 40837-byte TYPE/VALUE packet has 563 LF lines, exactly 25 `ACTUAL_TYPE` entries and one complete `DEFINITION_VALUE`, with no ellipsis, truncation marker or unresolved term/universe metavariable. Every independently parsed block matches its exact index hash, line interval, declaration name, kind and per-item AX list. Its owner set equals the complete owner report, with no missing or extra declaration.

## Full actual public TYPE and frozen interface

The complete public TYPE at packet lines1–293 was read, including every explicit binder, universe, elaborated instance, arithmetic expression, six lets and conclusion. The sole free sample universe is the rigid level parameter `u_1` in `{ΩB : Type u_1}`, its measurable space, Brownian process, probability measure and bridgeLaw application. It is not a fixed small sample type or an unresolved universe metavariable. The successful kernel object supplies the binding of that universe parameter; the actual head retains the arbitrary `Type*` source quantifier. The internal source02 `Type _` repair has not imposed an extra public universe restriction.

The existential positive real C precedes the Brownian sample type, law rho, support Bcap, dimension n, x and cap nu. Its only law assumptions are the actual probability/measurability/Brownian data, bounded support, mean zero, second moment one, n>0, x≥16, Bcap≤sqrt(n)/(200x), and the declared residual inequality. There is no added hidden premise about cap rotation invariance, stopping times, symmetry, atomlessness, density, masked independence, or a prior/rare payment.

The actual lets are exactly Q=bridgeLaw Bm PB; beta=the absolute third moment; delta=beta/sqrt(n); h0=4 beta²; P=the canonical iid product of rho over Fin n; and bill=the range-n sum of the actualDoubleSeparated family with the same arbitrary `nu a : LabelPerm n → Nat`. The only cap hypotheses are sectionwise measurability for each sigma and `nu a sigma≤energyCutoff a h0 sigma` for every a,sigma. The actual final conjunction is Measurable bill, Integrable bill under revealLaw P, pointwise bill≥0 for every pair, and its real integral≤C delta standardNormalTail(x).

The named actualDoubleSeparated in this TYPE is tied to the unchanged, previously completely read actual family definition: upper overshoot plus lower overshoot minus interval overshoot, with actualDerivativeFamily equal to the halfline derivatives and the actual intervalDerivative Q. The current exact source bindings for those imported definitions are checked. This is the full signed actual family, not an ordinary two-wall bound substituted for it. The two `labelPermMeasurableSpace` names appearing in the elaborated public TYPE are also checked: the new local prefix definition used for Measurable, and the imported SourcePermutationReveal definition fixed in revealLaw/Integrable, are both the same top measurable space. No new measurable-space variable is smuggled into the public statement.

The entire actual TYPE is semantically identical to the complete frozen import/prefix/head/end file SHA256 `593b398bda052641d986c67a446f8159fd7805a51b4723554fd8b77d6be38899`. Source bytes still match that frozen interface. The lengthy elaboration of the real path, bridge-noise subtype and normed-space instances only elaborates those same definitions; it does not alter a quantifier, law, constant, endpoint, or signed term.

## Actual owners, every TYPE and the unique FULLVALUE

The actual module-index inventory is **25 constants: 24 theorems and one definition; one public theorem**. This is derived from the successful original object and is distinct from the 90 source textual let/letI spans. Inline local values need not become module-owned constants; all 90 have their complete source-value/context coverage, and the original successful source elaboration plus exhaustive actual owner/value audit covers the actual encoding. No phantom 90-owner or unprinted-value census is claimed.

Every full actual TYPE at packet lines294–563 was read as well as the public TYPE. The 23 auxiliary theorem heads consist of standard proposition simplifications, nonzero/ordered algebra identities, arithmetic guard consequences, and two exact unfold equations. In particular, the arithmetic `_proof_16/_proof_17` guards follow from not(j<12), `_proof_19` asserts the positive successor guard, `_proof_18` derives r+1≤n from r:Fin n, and `_proof_20` supplies the nested-head subtraction guard. Their explicit extra rho,n,x binders are harmless unused parameters, not hidden assumptions in the public theorem.

The two foreign-namespace constants `Shao.C2.ActualDoubleSeparatedClassification.prefixAlive.eq_1` and `Shao.C2.ActualOneWallRecordEnvelope.oppositePrefixHit.eq_1` are actually owned by this new module and included in all 25 TYPE/AX checks. Their complete actual heads respectively identify prefixAlive with the original forall k≤r interior predicate, and oppositePrefixHit with the original exists k≤r signed-prefix≤−actualWall predicate. These match the accepted underlying definitions and the complete classification/prior-source review. Ownership is determined by module index, so neither was missed by assuming that its name prefix belonged to another producer.

The unique owned non-theorem is `Shao.Probability.SourceActualFullPositiveOvershoot.labelPermMeasurableSpace`. Its actual TYPE at468 is `(n:Nat)→MeasurableSpace(LabelPerm n)`. Its full actual value at470–493 was read completely, including every expanded lattice/order instance. It is exactly `fun n => Top.top`, hence the full measurable space, as frozen in the sole prefix instance. There are zero owned opaque, inductive, constructor, recursor, axiom or unsupported kinds omitted by the template. The coverage file records each of the 25 exact blocks and their mathematical role independently of their name suffix.

## Every recursive AX and warnings

All 25 actual recursive AX lists were read, cross-matched between packet, index and owner report, and checked individually against exactly `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`. The public theorem and unique definition use only that whitelist; other auxiliaries use subsets. The two foreign-namespace equation theorems are included. There is no sorryAx, new assumed axiom, native proof oracle or unsupported axiom in any actual owned declaration's recursive closure. This is the actual successful-original-object audit, not the earlier lexical absence of prohibited source tokens or a new compilation of a modified producer.

All 152 warning headers were read completely. Their exact categories are 88 deprecated aliases, nine tactic suggestions, three unused simp arguments, 28 unused-tactic linter notices, five never-executed tactic notices, 18 unnecessary tactic-sequencing notices, and one mathlib worktree-status warning. None is a source `sorry` warning or a failed mathematical goal. The unused/never-executed tactic warnings identify redundant proof commands after goals close, not an omitted premise or an unproved source statement. The nine suggestions include instance/tactic elaboration improvements; they do not replace the actual generated proof or the kernel/AX receipts. Existing deprecation aliases are interpreted by the pinned environment and need no source rewrite merely to accept this exact source.

The worktree-status warning is recorded separately: `mathlib: repository has local changes:`. Root supplied a fresh read-only HEAD/status/byte comparison and a separate read-only topology response. The complete large response was parsed deterministically, with no source inventory dumped into the report or copied into this review bundle. Its 9418 tracked logical paths all have actual content SHA256 equal to their corresponding pinned Git blob, including all 9241 Lean-source paths. There are zero changed Lean-byte paths, and HEAD is exactly `807d3836b165983210ee2ecf3cd28f239436949c`.

Git nevertheless reports 9401 D and 17 T rows, and 48130 untracked paths, of which 48116 are overlay .lake artifacts. The topology response shows .git, Mathlib and the top-level files are symlinks into the existing underlying pinned package, while the accepted overlay has its own .lake/build/lib/lean directory. The Git worktree view is therefore a thin symlink layout rather than the ordinary directories/regular files described by the reused index. Its `.gitignore` access warning about symbolic-link levels is recorded as part of that view's Git diagnostics. This is a nonempty Git status, not a claim of zero filesystem differences, and the current logical source bytes remain pinned.

The compact analysis and separate topology receipt were fully read and match the independently parsed exact counts/hash equality. The full raw response SHA256 is `638613f7c9589f0ad67ee2ce424ac748315bec693113c6643bfc137ed7f28716`, 6873233 bytes; its compact evidence retains that hash while the detailed inventory is left with Root/server evidence rather than duplicated here. These observations performed zero Lean/AX/package writes. Together with the prior accepted package view specified in SERVER.md, actual fixed-file API checks and source-bound accepted import-object map, they resolve the warning without an unaccounted semantic dependency change. No warning requires source changes or replay of an accepted producer.

## Scope, evidence combination, and release

This supplement combines one qualified author-separated complete source review chain with the exact source04 native pass, same-original-object complete owner TYPE/FULLVALUE/recursive AX audit, and full actual interface reading above. All required facets are satisfied for this exact declaration/source/object, so final formal qualification is true. It does not certify a new implementation or a broader original-paper statement beyond the frozen actual full signed separated-overshoot payment. Root integration/publication is a separate acceptance step; C2/C12/OQ56 remain OPEN, original C1 immutablev85 remains complete, and OQ3 remains paused by the user.

The role remains prescribed gpt-6.1-sol/xhigh. Actual model/effort and separate input/cached-input/output/reasoning-subset telemetry are unavailable and recorded as null, with no subscription allocation inferred. Every review write is confined to this new machine-supplement001 directory. Old source-stage metadata remains historically correct at its own seal and is not rewritten to show later machine evidence.

Final verdict, exact input/output seals, owner coverage and zero-inflight release are recorded alongside this report. Any material unresolved evidence gap must be stated there rather than hidden behind a native RC0. This is a bounded complete independent review stage, with no claim of persistent execution after release.
